mutations.name: Strip Upstream Evidence
mutations.description: When upstream returns 0 records, verdict must downgrade to FAIL.

mutations.name: Fake Cache as Live Success
mutations.description: When query is not executed and data is from cache, verdict must downgrade to CACHE_ONLY.

mutations.name: Unapproved Paid API Charge Gate
mutations.description: When AUTO_PAID_RESEARCH=false, paid operations must be COST_BLOCKED.

mutations.name: Ad ID as Product Title Leakage
mutations.description: When Ad ID leaks into product title, identity validation must FAIL.

mutations.name: Short Demand Window (< 60 Days)
mutations.description: When demand time series spans < 60 days, status must downgrade to INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY.
